column3: [imports] test-suite/corpus/pycsl-reference/10490_r635_timeit_string_rebinds_submodule_false.py: the program manipulates the import system (`import timeit (with `zu75a.b` resolved to a local file)`), so what its `import` statements load is decided at run time, while pycsl resolves them statically from the source tree — the contracts it would believe may belong to a different module than the one CPython runs (route #326: after `sys.path.insert(0, '.../alt')` CPython imported `alt/sp19.py` and pycsl PROVED the script-directory copy's contract). FIX: import the module by its package path instead of editing sys.path / sys.modules or loading it dynamically.
